snippet.title: Splatoon Raiders launches July 23rd! (Nintendo Switch 2)
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-2-games/Splatoon-Raiders-2846969.html?utm_medium=social&utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=SplatoonRaiders%7CNULL%7CReleaseDateAnnouncementTrailer%7Cm_id_daa741ae09%7C2846969

Splat scores of enemies and hunt for treasure in Splatoon Raiders, a new single-player focused Splatoon game – launching July 23rd, exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
